summary: One-cell gate writes .done into production OUT_ROOT (or crashes on the <4-contexts guard), so the un-forced Phase-2 sweep skips the first cell — shipping it as a 1x1 fixture or aborting the whole run
evidence: issue813_dispatch.sh:108-113 runs run_cell with --max-contexts 1 --max-questions 1 --force against production OUT_ROOT; issue813_run_cell.py:380 skips if sentinel exists and not --force, :458 raises if len(kept)<4 (the gate's 1 ctx trips this under set -euo pipefail), :516-532 writes .done; issue813_dispatch.py:130-155 _cell_cmd never passes --force to Phase-2. Fix: isolated temp out-root or --gate-only mode (no sentinel/summary), or delete gate outputs before Phase 2.

summary: substrate_matters verdict + null use raw Delta_med, not the registered Delta/floor; the raw-Delta null band is not persisted in Delta/floor space, so the registered band is unrecoverable post-hoc
evidence: issue813_analysis.py:379-389 verdict reads observed_by_sub[s]['delta_med'] (raw), null_x from null_p95; :149-169 _pseudo_delta_median returns a raw median with no per-pseudo-arm floor; :292-299 pairwise reads delta_med. Plan §3/§6/§6.5 register H1/H0 on Delta/floor within max(LOCO floor, substrate-swap null). delta_over_floor IS persisted per cell (:116/:135) so the scalar verdict is recoverable, but the null-band comparison in Delta/floor space is NOT (no persisted pseudo-floor per resample). Fix: compute the null in Delta/floor space (divide each pseudo-arm by its refit floor) OR add verdict_space:'raw_delta_med' + persist per-resample Delta/floor null so the analyzer reconstructs the registered band.

summary: Per-file HfApi().upload_file inside the per-(context,question) loop makes ~23,850 commits, blowing the HF 256/hr throttle the plan §8/§9 explicitly required bulk upload_folder to avoid (#664/#488)
evidence: issue813_run_cell.py:253-259 _hf_upload_file uses HfApi().upload_file (one commit per call), called at :345 inside the (context,question) loop in _extract_pairs (:306-347). Cell count Σ(50 ctx × K_q) ≈ 23,850 (plan §9 line 255). Plan §8 (line 225) requires 'ONE upload_folder commit per cell-dir' and §9 (line 270) 'per-cell bulk upload_folder (not per-file, per upload-policy.md #664)'. upload-policy.md: HF 256 commits/hr, multi-cell sweeps upload per-cell not per-file. Fix: batch each cell into a bounded chunk / one create_commit with multiple CommitOperationAdd, preserving delete-after-upload.

summary: Plan §4.4/§7 require a behavioral apply-parity probe (HALT on drift) before Phase 1; the .sh only logs a breadcrumb and relies on the config gauge assert, which cannot catch an rsLoRA apply drift
evidence: issue813_dispatch.sh:88-96 echoes '[phase=apply_parity] rsLoRA apply-gauge asserted in-process' and never runs a behavioral probe or HALTs; issue813_run_cell.py:398 assert_adapter_gauge checks r/alpha/use_rslora config match only. Plan §4.3 Phase 0.5 'MUST PASS before Phase 1', §4.4 'On drift → HALT (rsLoRA_apply_parity_drift)', §7 gate 1 'On FAIL → HALT'. Config gauge != the behavioral read that catches an alpha/sqrt(r)-vs-alpha/r apply mismatch that silently corrupts M+. Non-blocking demotion: the implementer (d)-flag + .sh note say the experimenter runs the behavioral probe manually before the sweep, and it corrupts no persisted artifact on its own — wire the automated HALT to close the manual-step gap.
